title: About Us
heading: Join Hands, Change the World
description: Charitize is an independent non-profit initiative driven by Akiyun Macapinlac as a one-man team. We believe that with dedication, passion, and modern technology, a single focused individual can spark meaningful impact. Every hand extended in kindness brings us closer to a world free from suffering.

soloFounder.name: Akiyun Macapinlac
soloFounder.bio: Building this platform as a one-man team, I manage every stage from full-stack web engineering and digital donation pipelines to partner cause coordination. Our lean, transparent model guarantees that help goes straight to those who need it most.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to uplift underprivileged communities by providing resources, education, and tools for growth through agile, transparent solo-led initiatives.
points: No one should go to bed hungry.
We spread kindness and direct support.

donationCallout.text: Through your donations, we spread kindness and support to children and families in need.
